Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer provided conflicting information regarding the location of Raisan Railway Station. While the search results mentioned Raisen Railway Station in India (Madhya Pradesh) as the most likely match, there were also results indicating a Raisan Railway Station in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. WebSurfer failed to adequately address or investigate the ambiguity in the search results, leading to an incomplete analysis. This oversight caused the Planner to finalize the task based on an assumption that Raisen Railway Station in India was the correct match, without considering the possibility of Raisan Railway Station being in Pakistan. This error directly impacted the final conclusion of the problem.
